dedupe_keys.name: electricity generation from solar and wind power

description: Electricity Generation from Solar and Wind Power is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset provides information about world electricity generation from solar and wind (1965–2025), measured in terawatt-hours. Source: Ember (2026); Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2025) – with major processing by Our World in Data. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are Electricity Generation. The portal shows 2026-05-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
